title: Every scanner drops wifi in one warehouse bay

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

input.subject: Wifi dropping in bay 4 - all the scanners

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
All three scanner tablets keep dropping off the wifi in bay 4 since Monday. They're fine in the other bays. We're having to walk to bay 3 to sync, which is slowing picking right down.

Dan

handling.escalation_reason: An access-point or coverage fault needs someone on site.

rationale: Several devices failing in one place and fine elsewhere points at the access point, not the tablets, so network_connectivity. Several people are slowed but can work by walking to bay 3; P2 is a judgement between the definitions (G1) — reviewer to confirm. The VPN runbook does not apply to warehouse wifi.
